name.description: The name of the custom provider

description.description: Description of payment gateway. Shown on the payments integrations page as subtext

paymentsUrl.description: This url will be loaded in iFrame to start a payment session.

queryUrl.description: The url used for querying payments related events. Ex. verify, refund, subscription etc.

imageUrl.description: Public image url for logo of the payment gateway displayed on the payments integrations page.

_id.description: The unique identifier for the custom provider.

deleted.description: Whether the config is deleted or not. true represents config is deleted

createdAt.description: The creation timestamp of the custom provider.

updatedAt.description: The last update timestamp of the custom provider.

traceId.description: Trace id of the custom provider.
